info.title: Innovation Sandbox on AWS
info.description:
Innovation Sandbox on AWS enables cloud administrators to automate the
management of temporary sandbox environments by implementing service
control policies, spend controls, and account recycling mechanisms.

The API is organized into these domains:

- **Accounts**: Register and manage sandbox accounts, cleanup runs, and
  account lifecycle actions.
- **Blueprints**: Register and manage CloudFormation StackSet-backed
  blueprints.
- **Configurations**: Read and update solution settings for leases, cleanup,
  notifications, maintenance, terms of service, and cost reporting.
- **Leases**: Request and manage temporary sandbox access, lifecycle actions,
  sharing, and principal assignments.
- **Lease templates**: Define the reusable budget, duration, blueprint, and
  visibility settings used to request leases.
- **Permission sets**: Discover IAM Identity Center permission sets available
  for lease permission profiles.
- **Principals**: Search IAM Identity Center users and groups for lease
  assignments.
- **Sandbox Agent**: AI agent that lets users interact with their sandbox
  account via natural language.

post.description:
Register an AWS account with ISB. Accepts only `awsAccountId`; rejects an ISB
administration account (400) and unknown body keys (400, strict). Returns the
registered account (201). The Entry->CleanUp Organizations move surfaces a 409
(ConflictError) when the account is no longer where expected (someone moved it
out of the Entry OU) or the organization was concurrently modified — the same
mapping the other OU-moving actions carry.

get.description:
Returns every configuration section plus the deploy-time fields the settings
UI needs. A never-saved section is returned with its code-default field values,
a null `lastSavedBy`, and no `meta`.

Reads the `agent` configuration section: its current values (or code defaults
if never saved) plus the `lastSavedBy` audit field. Governs the Sandbox Spaces
chat feature and its per-principal token budget.

echo `meta.lastEditTime` from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409

Creates a Bedrock model catalog entry or updates its enabled state.

A PRIVATE template is reported as 404 rather than 403 to callers without the
Admin or Manager role, so the response does not disclose that the identifier

put.description:
Replaces a lease template.

The body carries the full template, not a patch. `uuid`, `createdBy` and
`blueprintName` are server-owned and are not part of the writable input;
supplying them is rejected as an unknown member. `createdBy` is preserved
from the existing template on write.

Omitting `predictiveBudgetEnabled` keeps the stored value. A sent
`rateLimits` list replaces the stored list; a non-empty list requires
`predictiveBudgetEnabled`, and an empty list is always accepted. Omitting
`rateLimits` keeps the stored list while `predictiveBudgetEnabled` is true
and clears it otherwise. A `PREDICTED` budget threshold likewise requires
`predictiveBudgetEnabled`.

The write is conditioned on the template as read for validation; if it
changed in between, the update fails with ConflictError and is not applied.

Paginated list of leases. Admin/Manager callers list all leases (or filter by
`userEmail`); a regular caller may only list their own (`userEmail` must be
their own, else 403 `AccessDeniedError`). Each result item carries a `leaseId`.
`maxResults` caps at 2000.

post.description:
Request a new lease from a template. Returns the created lease (201) WITHOUT a
`leaseId`. A cross-user (on-behalf) request is Admin/Manager only. `assignments`
accepts up to 20 principals with one permission set each, but the final
desired state is capped at 20 total including the required owner. New
group-to-lease associations are rejected when `leases.groupAssignmentMode`
is `NONE`; user assignments remain allowed.

Retry: NOT `@idempotent`. Requesting a lease allocates an account and publishes
events; a retried request creates a second lease.

patch.description:
Update a monitored (active) lease. PATCH semantics: every body member is
optional. Returns the updated lease (200) WITHOUT a `leaseId`. The nullable
members (`maxSpend`, `expirationDate`, `costReportGroup`, and `rateLimits`)
accept an explicit `null` to CLEAR the value. Non-monitored leases are
rejected 400 (`ValidationError`); a missing lease is 404.

put.description:
Replace a lease's desired principal assignments (declarative). Each
principal selects exactly one permission set. Accepted
asynchronously: success is 202 with `{ desiredCount }` — the assignment worker
reconciles out of band. `@idempotent`: PUT sets the desired set, so a retry
converges to the same state. `assignments` is capped at 20 principals, including
the lease owner. Owner callers require
lease sharing enabled globally and on the lease (else 403). When group assignment
mode is `NONE`, existing group-to-lease associations may remain or be removed,
but new associations are rejected. 404 when missing; 409 when the lease is not
active or another operation holds the lock.

get.description:
Get a lease's Bedrock token series, newest-first: one entry per reading per
region and model, with `maxResults` counting readings.
Authorization is the same as `GetLease` — Admin/Manager may read any lease, any
other caller only one they own or are assigned to, 403 even when the lease does
not exist so existence is not leaked. 404 for an authorized caller.

A range's first change is measured from the reading before it: read it with
`beforeTimestamp` set to the range start and `maxResults` 1, as a single request,
not through a paginator (with the AWS CLI, `--no-paginate`). An empty page with a
`nextPageIdentifier` means that reading could not be read.

A page can return fewer than `maxResults` readings, or none, and still include a
`nextPageIdentifier`; it also ends early at a size limit. Keep requesting pages
until `nextPageIdentifier` is absent.

post.description:
Approve or deny a pending lease. Body carries `action` (`Approve`/`Deny`). The
success body is `{"status":"success"}`. A pending request that already contains
a group can still be approved when `leases.groupAssignmentMode` is `NONE`; the
mode blocks creation of new group-to-lease associations, not completion of an
existing request. 404 when missing; 409 when the lease is not pending review or
(on approve) no account is available.

get.description:
Searches IDC principals for the assignment UI.

Two modes on one route, selected by `exact`:
  - fuzzy (`exact=false`, the default): case-insensitive substring match over
    the cached principals, capped at `limit`; requires
    `leases.enablePrincipalSearch` (else 403 `AccessDeniedError`);
  - exact (`exact=true`): resolves one principal by exact attribute through IDC;
    requires a non-empty `q` and a specific `type`
    (`users` or `groups`, not `all`) — otherwise 400 — and returns 404 when no
    principal resolves. Exact lookups bypass `leases.enablePrincipalSearch`,
    but group lookups still require `leases.groupAssignmentMode` to be `ALL`.

When `leases.groupAssignmentMode` is `NONE`, explicit fuzzy or exact group
searches return 403, and unfiltered fuzzy searches return users only. Existing
group associations remain visible through lease assignment reads.

Applies these defaults when a parameter is absent: `q=""`, `type=all`,
`limit=20`, `exact=false`.

This operation is not paginated: it is a typeahead search, not a
list/describe. The caller shows the top `limit` matches (≤ 100) and never
pages; `totalMatches` exists only so the UI can show "N of M".

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against display name and email.

AssignmentSyncStatus.description:
Per-principal reconciliation status of a lease assignment. Each in-flight
state pairs with the failure it becomes if it never settles
(`granting` → `grantFailed`, `revoking` → `revokeFailed`):
- `active` — desired and assigned.
- `granting` — desired, not yet assigned; an operation is in flight.
- `revoking` — assigned but on its way out.
- `suspended` — intentionally not assigned because the lease grants nobody
  access (frozen or terminal, or a freeze/terminate in flight); expected,
  not a failure.
- `grantFailed` — desired and settled, but no assignment exists.
- `revokeFailed` — settled, but an assignment exists that should not: either
  the principal is no longer desired, or the lease grants no access.

AssignmentView.description:
One row of the assignments view: the union of a lease's desired set and its
live assignments, annotated with reconciliation state. Rows sourced only from
the desired set have no assignment yet, so `assigneeEmail`/`addedBy`/`addedDate`
are absent.

Spend at the time of the breach where the evaluator compared a figure
other than the bill alone. Null on a `LEASE_MONITORING` breach. On a
`TOKEN_POLL` breach, the spend with the monitored Bedrock token
cost substituted for the billed Bedrock slice, never below the billed
total.

The monitored Bedrock term substituted into `evaluatedSpendAtFire`,
before its floor at the billed total. Absent on a `LEASE_MONITORING`
breach, and on a `TOKEN_POLL` breach where none was substituted: no
priced token row yet, or no billed Bedrock slice to replace.

Only the token poll records the monitored Bedrock token cost.

Defaults to false when not configured.

lastSavedBy.description: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a `system:` sentinel.

nextPageIdentifier.description: Opaque continuation token. Omitted on the final page.

permissionSetArn.description: IAM Identity Center permission set ARN.

permissionSetId.description: Stable permission set identifier parsed from the ARN.

PermissionSetSummary.description: Public catalog summary for one available permission set.

permissionSetArn.description: IAM Identity Center permission set ARN.

permissionSetId.description: Stable permission set identifier parsed from the ARN.

Principal.description: A resolved IDC principal in the search response.

principalId.description: IDC identifier for the user or group.

displayName.description:
Human-readable name shown in the assignment UI. Optional: may be absent
when the principal has no display name.

email.description: Present for users, absent for groups.

PrincipalSearchResult.description:
The `data` payload of a principal search: the (capped) matches plus the total
that matched before `limit` was applied.

totalMatches.description: Total matches before the `limit` cap (the returned list may be shorter).

PrincipalSearchTypeFilter.description:
The `type` query filter: restrict to users, groups, or both. The public wire
values are lowercase.

PrincipalType.description: Whether a matched principal is an IDC user or group.

enabled.description: Whether this model is available in the chat UI.

expectedLastEditTime.description:
OCC token from the prior read's `meta.lastEditTime`.
Omit on the first call; required on subsequent calls.

RateBasis.description: The window a rate is measured over.

RateLimitEntry.description:
One spend-rate limit: the measured rate of `basis` reaching `rate` (USD per
hour or per day) takes `action`. The rate must be greater than zero, and a
list may not repeat a (basis, rate) pair; both rules are enforced by the
service rather than by a schema constraint.

rate.description: Spend-rate threshold in USD per the period selected by basis.

leaseTemplateUuid.description:
Template to request from. Public request field name (not
`originalLeaseTemplateUuid`).

userEmail.description: On-behalf target user. Omitted for a self-request.

ResourceCountByType.description: Counts of resources found, by phase.

ResourceLock.description: Record-level optimistic lock. Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings.

ResourceSummary.description: Resource-scan summary written after cleanup validation.

validationMode.description:
Validation mode in effect: `Quarantine` enforces (a failed validation
quarantines the account); `Warn` surfaces remaining resources without
blocking; `Silent` records metrics only. Absent if validation did not run.

ReviewAction.description: The review decision for a pending lease.

SandboxAccountStatus.description:
The account's operational state (the ISB OU it sits in, excluding the
transient Entry/Exit OUs). Registered accounts are always one of these.

spendByUsers.description:
Admins and Managers: every user with recorded usage. Users: only the
caller, with a zero entry when they have no recorded usage.

SandboxSpacesUserSpend.description: One user's Sandbox Spaces estimated token cost on the lease.

sandboxSpacesEstimatedTokenCostAccrued.description: This user's accumulated Sandbox Spaces estimated token cost in US dollars.

SelectableModel.description: One model a lease user may select for a Sandbox Space turn.

ServiceBreakdown.description: Cumulative cost keyed by Cost Explorer service name.

SharedLease.description:
A `Lease` reachable through a shared assignment, with the access path and
(for group access) the group that granted it. Also carries the `leaseId`.

userEmail.description: Lease owner / assignee email. Half of the composite key.

uuid.description: Server-generated lease UUID. Half of the composite key.

originalLeaseTemplateUuid.description: UUID of the lease template this lease was requested from.

originalLeaseTemplateName.description: Name copied from the template at request time.

createdBy.description: Set only for a cross-user (on-behalf) request; the elevated caller's email.

blueprintId.description:
Blueprint copied from the template for deployment. Absent when the template had
none.

predictiveBudgetEnabled.description:
Predictive budget controls opt-in. Copied from the template at creation
and replaceable through `UpdateLease`.

bedrockTokenMonitoringEnabled.description:
Bedrock token monitoring opt-in. Saved at creation as the template's
preference, or true when the template enables Sandbox Spaces, and
replaceable through `UpdateLease`.

sandboxSpacesEnabled.description: Snapshot of the source template's Sandbox Spaces on/off setting.

allowedModelIds.description:
Snapshot of the template's Sandbox Spaces model subset — the lease's own
copy, so a later template edit never changes enforcement under a running
lease.

defaultModelId.description:
Snapshot of the template's Sandbox Spaces default model, preselected first
when a chat opens under this lease.

lastPredictedSpend.description:
Predicted spend now, in USD, as of the last threshold check. The next
check compares against it. Lease Monitoring and Token Poll exclude
Sandbox Spaces estimated token cost.

lastEvaluatedSpend.description:
Spend so far, in USD, as of the last threshold check, with the
monitored Bedrock token cost in place of the billed Bedrock part
where token monitoring is on, never below the billed total. The next
check compares against it. Lease Monitoring and Token Poll exclude
Sandbox Spaces estimated token cost.

lastEvaluatedHourlySpendRate.description: Most recently evaluated hourly spend rate.

lastEvaluatedDailySpendRate.description: Most recently evaluated daily spend rate.

desiredAssignments.description:
Declarative desired principal assignments (owner + shared users/groups),
each optionally enriched with display metadata for the assignments UI.

ttl.description: TTL as a Unix-epoch-seconds timestamp. Present on terminal/denied leases.

leaseId.description:
A lease's public identifier: the base64url-encoded `{userEmail, uuid}` composite
key (URL-safe alphabet, no padding). Present on read/unfreeze outputs and list
items; absent from the `Lease` returned by `RequestLease`/`UpdateLease`.

sourceGroupName.description:
The IDC group display name that granted access, present only for
`group` access.

allowedPermissionSets.description:
Backend-hydrated metadata for the effective allowed set, including the
default. Missing cache entries remain represented as UNAVAILABLE.

selectableModels.description:
Enabled catalog narrowed to this lease's allowed models. Set by
`GetLease` and `UnfreezeLease` when Sandbox Spaces is enabled globally
and on the lease, resolved on each read so disabling a model takes
effect on the next fetch. Unset otherwise and on list responses.

rateLimits.description:
Spend-rate limits stored on this lease, each with its own action. Copied
from the template at creation and replaceable through `UpdateLease`.
Evaluated only while `predictiveBudgetEnabled` is true.

SharedLeaseAccessType.description:
The access path by which a shared lease reaches a user: a direct principal
assignment or membership in an assigned group. Wire values are lowercase.

blueprintId.description:
A blueprint id — the server-generated UUID. The pattern is the exact RFC layout
(versions 1–8, variant 8/9/a/b, plus the nil and max UUIDs), so a hex-shaped but
RFC-invalid id is rejected 400 rather than returning 404.

StackSetSummary.description:
A CloudFormation StackSet summary. `status`/`permissionModel` are open strings
(CloudFormation passthroughs; `permissionModel` may be absent in member accounts).

content.description: Terms-of-service text displayed to users before requesting a lease.

lastSavedBy.description: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a `system:` sentinel.

TokenSeriesRow.description:
One Bedrock token reading, flattened per region per model. `monitoredBedrockTokenCost` is
lease-wide as of `timestamp`, so it repeats across the rows sharing one and
summing it across rows double-counts. It prices only the tokens attributed to
a model, each at the rate when it was counted; a token with no rate adds
nothing. It is absent only on older rows saved unpriced.

modelId.description:
The Bedrock ModelId, or "unattributed" for counts that could not be matched
to a model; those counts are never priced into `monitoredBedrockTokenCost`.

UnauthenticatedErrorResponseContent.description: Identity token missing, expired, invalid, or lacking required claims.

UnregisteredAccount.description:
An AWS Organizations account in the Entry OU that has not been registered
with ISB. Field names mirror the Organizations API (`Id`, `Email`, `Name`).

UnsupportedMediaTypeErrorResponseContent.description:
`Content-Type` is not a JSON media type. (An acceptable media type carrying
an invalid or absent payload also currently returns 415.)

UpdateAgentConfigurationRequestContent.description:
Optimistic-concurrency envelope accepted on a section write. Only
`meta.lastEditTime` is read (the concurrency token); the server derives the rest.
`createdTime` is server-owned and is deliberately NOT part of the write contract;
`lastSavedBy` is server-owned and stripped if supplied.

sandboxSpacesEnabled.description:
Global Sandbox Spaces capability. `true` turns the feature on for
every role with an active lease (still subject to the enabled-model
catalog gate); `false` turns it off entirely.

cooldownPeriodHours.description:
Hours to hold an account in the CleanUp OU after a successful cleanup before
returning it to Available (`0` = disabled; max 8640 = 360 days).

costReportGroups.description: Valid cost-report-group values selectable on lease templates.

requireCostReportGroup.description: Whether a cost report group is required on lease templates.

UpdateLeaseAssignmentsResult.description: The count of desired assignments accepted for reconciliation.

defaultPermissionSetArn.description: Replace the lease's default permission set.

items.description: IAM Identity Center permission set ARN.

allowedPermissionSetArns.description: Replace the permission sets available for assignment overrides.

sandboxSpacesEnabled.description: Turn Sandbox Spaces on or off for this lease.

allowedModelIds.description:
Replace the lease's Sandbox Spaces model subset. Clearable: an explicit
null inherits every enabled catalog model.

defaultModelId.description: Replace the model preselected when a chat opens. Clearable with null.

rateLimits.description:
Replace the spend-rate limits. Clearable: the edit forms send an
explicit null, which the client re-injects into the body (the
serializer omits nulls). An empty list also clears. A non-empty list
requires predictive budget controls on. Omitting it in a request
that sets `predictiveBudgetEnabled` to false clears the stored limits.

predictiveBudgetEnabled.description:
Turn predictive budget controls on or off. Turning them on requires
`allowPredictiveBudgetControls`. While they are off, a `PREDICTED`
budget threshold or a non-empty `rateLimits` list is rejected.

bedrockTokenMonitoringEnabled.description:
Turn Bedrock token monitoring on or off. Turning it on requires
`allowBedrockTokenMonitoring` or `sandboxSpacesEnabled` true. Must be
true while `sandboxSpacesEnabled` is true. Send false in a request that
turns `sandboxSpacesEnabled` off while `allowBedrockTokenMonitoring` is off.

UpdateLeaseTemplateRequestContent.description:
The client-writable members of a lease template, shared by the create and
update inputs. Both accept the same set — requiredness and constraints are
identical and neither operation is a patch.

`uuid`, `createdBy` and `blueprintName` are deliberately absent — they are
server-owned.

blueprintId.description: Blueprint to attach. `blueprintName` is resolved server-side.

predictiveBudgetEnabled.description: Opt-in: spend rates, cost projection, predicted-cost thresholds and caps.

bedrockTokenMonitoringEnabled.description:
Opt-in: monitored Bedrock token cost tracking. Must be true when
`sandboxSpacesEnabled` is true.

sandboxSpacesEnabled.description:
Whether leases created from this template have Sandbox Spaces turned on.
`true` requires `bedrockTokenMonitoringEnabled`; otherwise the request
is rejected with 400.

allowedModelIds.description:
Sandbox Spaces: subset of the globally enabled model IDs this template
permits. Unset inherits the global enabled set.

defaultModelId.description:
Sandbox Spaces: model preselected for new chats on leases from this
template. Must be enabled and, when a subset is set, one of allowedModelIds.

defaultPermissionSetArn.description: Permission set assigned when an assignment does not specify an override.

items.description: IAM Identity Center permission set ARN.

allowedPermissionSetArns.description:
Permission sets available for assignment overrides. The default is
implicitly allowed and this list is capped at 20 entries.

rateLimits.description:
Spend-rate limits, each with its own action. A non-empty list
requires `predictiveBudgetEnabled`. When sent, it replaces the stored
list. See the operation for omission rules.

ttl.description:
Number of days the solution stores expired lease records before purging
them.

allowUserLeaseTermination.description: Whether users can self-terminate their own active leases.

leaseRequestWindowHours.description: Rolling window duration (hours) for rate-limiting lease requests.

maxLeaseRequestsPerWindow.description: Maximum number of leases a user can request within the rolling window.

leaseSharingEnabled.description: Whether the multi-user lease-sharing feature is globally enabled.

enablePrincipalSearch.description: Whether the `GET /principals/search` typeahead API is available.

allowPredictiveBudgetControls.description:
Predictive Budget Controls feature gate: allows templates and leases to
opt into spend-rate limits, cost projection and predicted-cost thresholds.

serviceBreakdownEnabled.description: Whether per-service cost breakdown is collected.

allowBedrockTokenMonitoring.description: Feature gate for monitored Bedrock token cost tracking.

enabled.description: When true, prevents creation of new leases. Fresh installs default to true.

UpdateNotificationConfigurationRequestCo.description: Notification delivery: which channels are active and the SES sender.

emailFrom.description:
From address used for SES notification emails; an empty string leaves
SES unable to deliver even when `sesEnabled` is true.

sesEnabled.description: Whether SES email delivery is enabled. Defaults to true when not configured.

snsIntegrationTopicEnabled.description:
Whether publishing to the shared SNS integration topic is enabled.
Defaults to false when not configured.

content.description: Terms-of-service text displayed to users before requesting a lease.

ValidationErrorResponseContent.description: Request validation failed. `data.errors` carries per-field detail.

Visibility.description:
Lease-template visibility: `PUBLIC` templates are visible to all users;
`PRIVATE` templates are visible only to Admin and Manager roles.

aws.auth.sigv4.description: AWS Signature Version 4 over the `execute-api` service. Required on every request: the API uses IAM authorization (`AuthorizationType.IAM`), and there is no bearer-token or Cognito authorizer. The caller type is determined from the IAM principal.
aws.auth.sigv4.name: Authorization

isbIdentity.name: x-isb-identity
isbIdentity.description: Cognito ID token, verified via JWKS. Carries the claims used for RBAC. Required for human callers (Identity Pool roles). M2M callers (per-client assumed IAM roles) derive their role from the assumed-role ARN and must NOT send this header; a request presenting both an M2M principal and `x-isb-identity` is rejected with 400.
